name: Guru Krupa Gems and Jewellery Limited
about: Guru Krupa Gems and Jewellery Limited manufactures, wholesales, retails, and trades in gold and silver jewelry in India. The company offers gold jewellery with or without studded precious and semi-precious stones; and ornaments. It also provides rings, bracelets, necklaces, ear chains, earrings, pendants, chains, mangalsutra products, zuda products, toe rings, anklets, and bangles, etc. The company sells its products through its showroom. The company was formerly known as Bhakti Gems and Jewellery Limited and changed its name to Guru Krupa Gems and Jewellery Limited in February 2026. Bhakti Gems and Jewellery Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
